push.title: L 2-4 vs 4Das FC | You: 8.7
push.body:
buddskees, that 8.7 was a sturdy day's work. Proud of you.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at 4Das FC's goal. That's an attacking mindset.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (23 vs their best 22). That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Team-high 1 key passes. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (2). Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- 2 of 6 shots on target. Easy money: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. That's a coach's honest word.
- You and BellyTb1 can fix shot selection as a duo: cut it back to each other.
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Habit to build: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. We win together and we wear this together.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 1). One honest look at that and we move forward.

Drill: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

buddskees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

Shake it off and lace up. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.8 against 4Das FC. You're on the right road. Let's find the passing lane.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at 4Das FC's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ Every time you found buddskees, something good happened.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Passes attempted 36, up from your usual 25. Proof you've got another gear.

THE BAD
- 72% passing (26 of 36, down from your usual 80%). Here's how: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy. No sweat, just reps.
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Little adjustment: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound. That's how good becomes great.
- buddskees had the same shot selection gremlin. Squash it together: cut it back to each other.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Match 11 of the session and your rating had slid from 9.4 early on to 7.8. That's the kind of number that loses matches.

Rondo time: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Growth is messy, and that's okay. - Coach Lasso
